categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Longertek Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main segments: rail transit vehicle air conditioning and related maintenance services, new energy and intelligent thermal management products, air source heat pump drying equipment, and digital energy intelligent environmental control products including controllers. The company focuses on R&D, production, sales, and after-sales services in these areas, with a strong emphasis on energy-saving and environmentally friendly technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as intelligent variable frequency control, heat pump technology, DC direct drive compressors, and integrated thermal management systems. It employs specialized manufacturing lines for rail transit air conditioners and controllers, supported by digital and intelligent production systems including MES and APS. The firm also emphasizes R&D in new refrigerants, lightweight materials, noise reduction, and smart predictive maintenance, supported by extensive patent holdings and certified laboratories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major rail vehicle manufacturers, notably China CRRC and its subsidiaries, as well as leading domestic and international rail transit operators. The company also serves new energy vehicle manufacturers, commercial vehicle producers, and clients in the energy storage, data center, and agricultural drying sectors. Its products are deployed across numerous Chinese cities and exported to countries such as Italy, Malaysia, Vietnam, Israel, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant sales in Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It also has a growing international presence with exports and projects in Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Oceania. The company maintains subsidiaries and offices in major Chinese cities including Jinan, Qingdao, Beijing, Shenzhen, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shandong Longertek functions primarily as a midstream manufacturer and supplier within the rail transit and new energy vehicle supply chains. It produces core air conditioning and thermal management systems integrated into vehicles and energy storage solutions. The company also extends into downstream services through maintenance and after-sales support, and upstream through R&D and component sourcing management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in variable frequency energy-saving control, new refrigerants, lightweight and noise reduction technologies, and integrated thermal management systems. It invests heavily in R&D to expand applications in high-speed rail, urban rail, new energy vehicles, digital energy, and heat pump drying. Future R&D focuses include DC1500V direct-drive air conditioners, environmentally friendly refrigerants (R513A, R744, R290), smart predictive maintenance, and liquid cooling for large-capacity energy storage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of air conditioning systems, thermal management products, and controllers, complemented by after-sales maintenance and repair services. The company also earns income from government subsidies, licensing, and related technical services. Sales are conducted mainly via bidding and direct contracts with large OEMs and operators, with a mix of domestic and international customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider in the rail transit vehicle air conditioning market, holding a stable market share due to its early advantage in variable frequency energy-saving technology. It competes with other specialized manufacturers in rail transit and new energy vehicle thermal management sectors. Its international competitiveness is growing through partnerships with global rail vehicle manufacturers like Alstom and Bombardier.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 880 million, a slight decrease of 2.35% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 76 million. Total assets reached around RMB 2.03 billion, up 10.74% from the previous year. Despite profitability challenges, the company is expanding its order backlog, especially in overseas markets, and increasing R&D investment, indicating a focus on long-term growth and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shandong Longertek emphasizes its core competencies in intelligent variable frequency energy-saving control, lightweight and low-noise design, and integrated thermal management solutions tailored for rail transit and new energy vehicles. Its products offer high reliability, energy efficiency, and environmental friendliness, supporting national carbon reduction goals. The company also differentiates through comprehensive after-sales service networks, advanced digital manufacturing, and strong R&D capabilities backed by extensive patents and certifications.
